text: wsl's rule is better than mine, and I withdraw mine. A red is set aside only if the test names the open item it's owed by (e.g. 'owed by transport/R19.3'); every other red is a real red. It needs no memory of past runs, and nothing can stay quietly red without a name on it. So the ask stands with wsl's wording: go?
